title: Roadside Claims Desk Standard: Service Eligibility under Towing and Labor Coverage
content:
A roadside service under **Towing and Labor Coverage**, whether performed by a provider the company dispatches or submitted on receipts for a service the customer arranged, is eligible on the terms below.

## Standard

1. The covered services are tow, jump-start, lockout, flat tire change, fuel delivery and winch-out. Labor is paid only at the place of disablement, up to 60 minutes; winching only within 100 feet of a paved road; and the cost of fuel, parts and key cutting is not paid.
2. The caller states who was driving and where the vehicle is disabled.
3. A service is eligible only when the disablement occurs no earlier than 48 hours after the coverage took effect. Elapsed hours are counted from 12:01 a.m. on the coverage effective date; a disablement on or after the end of the waiting hours qualifies.
4. The vehicle's paid disablements in the term must be below the package's term maximum before another is paid.
5. No service is paid during a lapse of the owner term, while a named excluded driver was operating, during ride-hailing or delivery use, or for an impound tow.
6. A tow after a covered collision or comprehensive loss is paid under physical damage instead.
7. Out-of-network receipts are accepted within 60 calendar days of the disablement.

## Where each fact comes from

| Fact | Source |
|---|---|
| Who was driving; where the vehicle is disabled | The caller's own statement, recorded with the service reference |
| Coverage effective date | The company's record of the vehicle's towing coverage |
| Paid disablements in the term | The company's benefit payment records for that vehicle's coverage |

## The waiting period (item 3)

The 48 hours are elapsed hours, and the clock starts at 12:01 a.m. on the coverage effective date. The boundary is inclusive: a disablement at the end of the 48 hours qualifies.

| Disablement occurs | Eligible |
|---|---|
| 47 elapsed hours after 12:01 a.m. on the effective date | No |
| Exactly 48 elapsed hours after 12:01 a.m. on the effective date | Yes |
| Later than 48 elapsed hours | Yes |

*Hypothetical:* a coverage effective on the 10th of a month; its waiting hours end 48 elapsed hours after 12:01 a.m. on the 10th, that is at 12:01 a.m. on the 12th. A disablement at 11:30 p.m. on the 11th is not eligible; one at 12:01 a.m. on the 12th or later is.

## Counting paid disablements (item 4)

The paid disablements in the term are the distinct service references on that vehicle's towing coverage that carry a benefit payment not fully reversed, with a disablement date within the owner term of the coverage, from its effective date to its expiration date.

| Package | Term maximum |
|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $50 | 3 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $75 | 3 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $100 | 3 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $125 | 4 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $150 | 4 |
| Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $200 | 5 |

*Hypothetical, Cardinal Point Towing and Labor $100 package (term maximum 3):*

| Paid disablements counted in the term | Below 3 | Another may be paid |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | Yes | Yes |
| 3 | No | No |
| 3, one of whose payments was later reversed in full | Counted as 2, below 3 | Yes |
